verdict_reason: The two mapping methods are correct and their ignore/unmapped policies are complete against Address, AddressRequest and OperatorResponse, but the mapper stops short of the update path so OperatorService.update duplicates the field copy by hand and escapes the compile-time drift guard this file advertises.

todos.issue: The mapper covers create (toEntity) and read (toResponse) but has no @MappingTarget update method, so OperatorService.update copies the 9 mutable fields by hand; the compile-time guard this mapper advertises (unmappedTarget/SourcePolicy = ERROR) does not reach the PUT path, and a future field added to AddressRequest+Address will compile clean while PUT silently fails to replace it (stale value persists on a full-replace endpoint).
todos.fix: Add 'void updateEntity(@MappingTarget Address entity, AddressRequest request)' with the same ignores as toEntity (id, organisationId, status, createdAt, modifiedAt; ignoreUnmappedSourceProperties type/role) and have OperatorService.update call it instead of the nine manual setters.
